name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site He
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=0.87, open boundary) for time t=1.46 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 40 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
